argument: The 26 slabs must read as one asymmetrical threshold before they read as 26 targets. The broken upper contour, unequal spacing, and dark field must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the blind view must leave v044's orbit, v045's mass, and v046's folded score. It should read as a singular arch whose structure can be missing, not a generic crowd diagram.

The visitor must make three explicit looks, not operate a parameter panel. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic gaze control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only gesture may carry the work.
A repeated witness, an incomplete chain, and short attention must leave every slab geometrically exact. Only three distinct looks may produce a change in the field.
The visited witnesses must turn as situated agents, but the archive must be carried by a remote absent slab. If the source simply lights up or dents, the reciprocal-attention translation fails.
A committed event must remove actual geometry and break the arch rail. A dark tint, status message, cursor halo, or label cannot substitute for the missing seat.
The order of the three witnesses must change the absent slot and the resulting turns. If the chain is only a set with a cosmetic order label, delete the direction.
Four defections must compound in one arch. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding signature and release must return to the quiet seed.
Generated Canvas 2D slabs, geometry-bearing turns, cut scars, and witness threads are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, external font, or animal drawing may carry the work.

little-critters is translated from situated proximity and reciprocal attention into a remote social absence. Animals, eyes, characters, paper, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.
v047 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal memory, and medium: additive WEBGL mass and cadence become a 2D threshold whose memory is a missing body.

Delete v047 if repeated or incomplete looks commit, the attended site is the only changed geometry, a gap is cosmetic, later absences reset, lifting is inexact, or the blind arch is merely a gate or crowd diagram.
